title: Pure Windwitch
summary: Windwitch cards only, with untagged WIND Synchros, Xyz and Links and staples. Windwitch is a WIND Spellcaster Synchro deck, and its summon locks keep the Extra Deck WIND: Glass Bell and Windwitch Chimes allow only WIND summons, and Ice Bell only Level 5+ WIND from the Extra Deck. The page's one-card combo leads. Windwitch - Ice Bell summons itself onto an empty field and Windwitch - Glass Bell from the Deck, and Glass Bell searches Windwitch - Snow Bell. Ice Bell and Glass Bell make Windwitch - Winter Bell. Winter Bell and Snow Bell then make Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, which Snow Bell protects from the opponent's effects. The 2021 cards add Windwitch - Freeze Bell and Windwitch - Blizzard Bell as extra bodies, Windwitch Chimes to summon a Windwitch from the Deck, and Windwitch - Diamond Bell to destroy a card whenever the opponent takes damage. Windwitch - Crystal Bell is left out, since the pure list has no Fusion Spell.
